findings.description: Unconditional SQLite BEGIN fails for a Python3.12 sqlite connection configured autocommit=False (already physical transaction), producing OperationalError and falsely marking durability compromised.
findings.reproduction: Temporary SQLite engine with connect_args={"autocommit":False}; Base.metadata.create_all(engine); backup(engine, temporary artifacts/archive/deletion manifest).
findings.observed: OperationalError (sqlite3.OperationalError) cannot start a transaction within a transaction; durability compromised warning.
findings.recommended_fix: Issue BEGIN only when connection.connection.driver_connection.in_transaction is false. Retain one-snapshot test for legacy mode and add modern transaction-mode regression.
